claude.performance_metric: Chapter 11 filed 2012-07-09; net loss deepened to $730.6M (FY2012)
claude.rationale: p5_pathway=1: the realized record centers on the operations/organization interface — the 10-K attributes rising liabilities to labor-related legacy liabilities and states the reorganization path depended on renegotiating wage, benefit, and retiree-healthcare obligations (Bankruptcy Code Sections 1113/1114) with the UMWA, with risk of labor disruptions/work stoppages, and documents a shift in workforce and UMWA representation over the window. p4_pathway=0: no documented disruption at the product/process interface (product-line/operations incoherence); the slice describes market and labor/legacy pressures, not an inability to align an acquired product with operating processes. t1 and t2 are uncertain because the slice provides no information about controlling-intent archetype coherence or business-model reconciliation.

gemini.performance_metric: Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing and $730.6 million net loss in FY2012
gemini.rationale: The slice documents severe pressure at the operations and labor interface, noting that rising labor-related legacy liabilities and the need to renegotiate UMWA wage and benefit programs drove the company into Chapter 11 bankruptcy (p5_pathway = 1). There is no documented evidence of product/process integration failure (p4_pathway = 0).

openai.performance_metric: Chapter 11 filing; FY2012 net loss of $730.6 million
openai.rationale: No realized product/process alignment failure is documented, so p4 is coded 0. These documented labor-and-legacy pressures coincided with the company operating as a debtor-in-possession and support a realized process/organization fracture.
